title: RAW_UNSCREENED: coordinated definite property pair as an oppositional state
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: treat recurring PGP40129 coordinated definite pairs as ordered two-property constructions, comparing an oppositional state model with flat list coordination while preserving exact conjunction attachment.

design.architecture: A complete-record model treats the repeated phrase אלחרארה ואלברודה as one ordered two-property construction [definite property A] ו[definite property B], preserving attached conjunction, order, and recurrence. Neighboring head/property constructions supply a carrier only as a provisional structural role; no thermal word value is imported.

source_evidence.quote:
3. **Definite coordination:** `אלחרארה ואלברודה` occurs in the selected
   pomegranate record at recto 19 and in the selected quince record at verso
   12; its further verso 19 occurrence is supplemental. The conjunction is
   attached to the second word in the source.

design.conditional_whole_reading: The ordered coordinated pair provisionally represents one contrastive state axis in a complete medical record; its two members remain unnamed until an independent endpoint binds the axis. Flat token reuse is not accepted as a positive result.
design.rival: The phrase is an ordinary copied list of two independently coordinated nouns, with no oppositional state relation and no stable scope beyond local adjacency.
design.falsifier: Pair order or construction role is unstable across all complete occurrences, or a held occurrence cannot distinguish ordered-pair and flat-list models without repairs or a fixed thermal gloss.
design.smallest_test: Freeze the three exact pair occurrences and complete neighboring clauses, then compare ordered-pair and flat-coordination models with a held occurrence and an independently defined contrast criterion.
